SOM.note: Vendor payments through ACH are stated, but no e-procurement system.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia says its National Payment System, launched July 2021, connects all licensed commercial banks, and that the Somali Payment Switch and Somali Instant Payment System launched in January 2025 on that foundation.

SOM.note: No consumer-protection rule or complaints body is stated.
Regional integration is mentioned only as a goal, with no corridor named.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia says the ACH component of its National Payment System supports bulk salary processing, enhancing the government's ability to pay its public workforce on time, and that SIPS enables Government-to-Person transactions.

SOM.note: The two-thirds figure is a share of payments, not a survey share of adults.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia says over two-thirds of payments in Somalia are already processed through mobile money and other digital platforms.
The Central Bank of Somalia says SIPS, launched January 2025, enables real-time 24/7 transfers between banks, mobile wallets and point-of-sale terminals regardless of provider.
The Central Bank of Somalia says the Somali Payment Switch and SIPS, launched January 2025, connect banks, mobile wallets and point-of-sale terminals in real time.
The Central Bank of Somalia says SOMQR, launched March 2023, lets customers pay for goods, services, taxes and fees by scanning a code.
